dynamic/conveyor.straight.mapping.encoding: Decoded bytes: across=R/255; along=(G*256+B)/65535; coverage=A/255; no premultiplication or color conversion

straight.composition: Use static alone, or base + arrow/dynamic overlay. Optional surface + edge-glow + edge-core replaces base; never double-stack base and its components.
straight.staticArrowPhaseSource: Shared animation phase: thresholded original atlas cell-0 intensity centroid at along=.5; no per-shape offset
straight.phaseStatus: One unit per grid piece; normalized polar corner preview, not recovered live conveyor mapping

parameters.source: ECS initialization/material values; not live runtime capture
parameters.clock: Shared route elapsed time; both independent effects continue across segment boundaries

textureProfile.coordinates: logical pixels; physicalRect and image dimensions are physical pixels
textureProfile.dataFilter: nearest packed height/flow coordinates; channel box continuous fields
